title: TAK Server
description: One TCP or TLS session to a TAK Server streaming port. Inbound: every Cursor on Target event (ATAK/WinTAK positions, markers) becomes an observation with a COT_UID identity. Outbound: entities the sharing policy allows are published as CoT tracks, alerts as markers, geofences and locations as shapes. Client certificates come from secretRefs clientCert, clientKey and caCert (PEM, usually file: references).

address.title: Server address
address.description: host:port of the streaming port: 8087 for plain TCP, 8089 for TLS with a client certificate.

siteId.title: Site id
siteId.description: Names this Sentinel in the uids it publishes and in the provenance marker used to ignore its own events coming back.

protocol.title: Wire protocol
protocol.description: XML CoT; TAK Protocol (protobuf) negotiation is not offered yet.

heartbeatSec.title: Heartbeat (s)
heartbeatSec.description: Interval of the t-x-c-t ping that keeps the session alive.

readTimeoutSec.title: Read timeout (s)
readTimeoutSec.description: Close and reconnect when nothing arrives for this long (0 = never).

staleSec.title: Stale after (s)
staleSec.description: How long a published track stays valid on TAK after its last fix.

how.title: CoT how
how.description: Default how attribute for machine-generated tracks.

emergencyMinSeverity.title: 911 alert from severity
emergencyMinSeverity.description: Alerts at or above this severity are sent as TAK emergencies, which take over every connected screen; empty never does.
